eips.title: EIP-3298: Remove storage-clear refund and refund cap
eips.description: Removes the SSTORE storage-clearing refund and the transaction refund cap, leaving only net-metered same-transaction write reversals
eips.authors: Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin), Martin Swende (@holiman), Jochem Brouwer (@jochem-brouwer)

eips.title: EIP-4758: Deactivate SELFDESTRUCT
eips.description: Deactivate SELFDESTRUCT by changing it to SENDALL, which does recover all funds to the caller but does not delete any code or storage.
eips.authors: Guillaume Ballet (@gballet), Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin), Dankrad Feist (@dankrad)

eips.title: EIP-5920: PAY opcode
eips.description: Introduces a new opcode, PAY, to send ether to an address without calling any of its functions
eips.authors: Gavin John (@Pandapip1), Zainan Victor Zhou (@xinbenlv), Sam Wilson (@SamWilsn), Jochem Brouwer (@jochem-brouwer), Charles Cooper (@charles-cooper)

eips.title: EIP-7645: Alias ORIGIN to SENDER
eips.description: Eliminate ORIGIN tech debt to lay groundwork for account abstraction and close security holes

eips.title: EIP-7666: EVM-ify the identity precompile
eips.description: Remove the identity precompile, and put into place a piece of EVM code that has equivalent functionality

eips.title: EIP-7668: Remove bloom filters
eips.description: Remove bloom filters from the execution block

eips.title: EIP-7686: Linear EVM memory limits
eips.description: Adjust memory limits and gas limits of sub-calls to create a clear linear bound on how much total memory an EVM execution can consume

eips.title: EIP-7709: Read BLOCKHASH from Storage and Update Cost
eips.description: Read the `BLOCKHASH (0x40)` opcode from the EIP-2935 system contract storage and adjust its gas cost to reflect storage access.
eips.authors: Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin), Tomasz Stanczak (@tkstanczak), Guillaume Ballet (@gballet), Gajinder Singh (@g11tech), Tanishq Jasoria (@tanishqjasoria), Ignacio Hagopian (@jsign), Jochem Brouwer (@jochem-brouwer), Gabriel Rocheleau (@gabrocheleau)

eips.title: EIP-7716: Anti-correlation attestation penalties
eips.description: Adjust penalties for missed attestations based on in-slot correlation of missed attestation

eips.title: EIP-7805: Fork-choice enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL)
eips.description: Allow a committee of validators to force-include a set of transactions in every block
eips.authors: Thomas Thiery (@soispoke) <thomas.thiery@ethereum.org>, Francesco D'Amato <francesco.damato@ethereum.org>, Julian Ma <julian.ma@ethereum.org>, Barnabé Monnot <barnabe.monnot@ethereum.org>, Terence Tsao <ttsao@offchainlabs.com>, Jacob Kaufmann <jacob.kaufmann@ethereum.org>, Jihoon Song <jihoon.song@ethereum.org>

eips.title: EIP-7807: SSZ execution blocks
eips.description: Migration of execution blocks to SSZ

eips.title: EIP-7819: SETDELEGATE instruction
eips.description: Introduce a new instruction allowing contracts to create clones using EIP-7702 delegation designations

eips.title: EIP-7851: Code-Controlled EOA Delegation
eips.description: Allow EIP-7702 delegated EOAs to update delegation through code while permanently disabling residual ECDSA authority.

eips.title: EIP-7862: Delayed State Root
eips.description: Separate state root computation from block validation
eips.authors: Charlie Noyes <charlie@paradigm.xyz>, Dan Robinson <dan@paradigm.xyz>, Justin Drake <justin@ethereum.org>, Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation)

eips.title: EIP-7906: Transaction Assertions via State Diff Opcode
eips.description: An opcode that provides a mechanism to restrict the outcomes of transaction execution
eips.authors: Alex Forshtat (@forshtat), Shahaf Nacson (@shahafn), Dror Tirosh (@drortirosh), Yoav Weiss (@yoavw), Fredrik Svantes (@0xfredrik)

eips.title: EIP-7923: Linear, Page-Based Memory Costing
eips.description: Linearize Memory Costing and replace the current quadratic formula with a page-based cost model.

eips.title: EIP-7979: Call and Return Opcodes for the EVM
eips.description: Three new instructions to support calls and returns.
eips.authors: Greg Colvin (@gcolvin) <greg@colvin.org>, Martin Holst Swende (@holiman), Brooklyn Zelenka (@expede), John Max Skaller

eips.title: EIP-8015: Remove `deposit` and `eth1data` fields
eips.description: Remove legacy deposit and Eth1 data fields from `BeaconBlockBody` and `BeaconState` after EIP-6110 finalization

eips.title: EIP-8025: Optional Execution Proofs
eips.description: Introducing optional execution proofs on the consensus layer
eips.authors: Kevaundray Wedderburn (@kevaundray), Justin Drake (@JustinDrake) <justin@ethereum.org>, Ignacio Hagopian (@jsign), Han (@han0110), Francesco Risitano (@frisitano), Cody Gunton (@codygunton)

eips.title: EIP-8058: Contract Bytecode Deduplication Discount
eips.description: Reduces gas costs for deploying duplicate contract bytecode via access-list based mechanism
eips.authors: Carlos Perez (@CPerezz), Wei Han Ng (@weiihann), Guillaume Ballet (@gballet)

eips.title: EIP-8077: eth/XX - announce transactions with nonce
eips.description: Adds source and nonce to transaction announcements

eips.title: EIP-8094: eth/vhash - Blob-Aware Mempool
eips.description: Make mempool messaging vhash aware

eips.title: EIP-8115: Batch priority fees at end of block
eips.description: Delay all priority fee credits from transactions to end of block

eips.title: EIP-8116: Replace cumulative receipt fields
eips.description: Replace cumulativeGasUsed with gasUsed in on-chain receipt

eips.title: EIP-8131: Unified Transaction Content Floor
eips.description: Flat 64 gas per content byte at the floor, covering all user-controlled transaction fields and capping worst-case block size.

eips.title: EIP-8141: Frame Transaction
eips.description: Add frame abstraction for transaction validation, execution, and gas payment
eips.authors: Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin), lightclient (@lightclient), Felix Lange (@fjl), Yoav Weiss (@yoavw), Alex Forshtat (@forshtat), Dror Tirosh (@drortirosh), Shahaf Nacson (@shahafn), Derek Chiang (@derekchiang), Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation), Stavros Vlachakis (@svlachakis)

eips.title: EIP-8142: Block-in-Blobs (BiB)
eips.description: Ensures execution payload data availability via blobs
eips.authors: Kevaundray Wedderburn (@kevaundray), Ignacio Hagopian (@jsign), Jihoon Song <jihoon.song@ethereum.org>, Francesco Risitano (@frisitano), Thomas Thiery (@soispoke) <thomas.thiery@ethereum.org>, Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation), Péter Garamvölgyi (@thegaram)

eips.title: EIP-8146: Block Access List Sidecars
eips.description: Propagate block access lists as independent sidecars, off the critical path and ahead of the execution payload

eips.title: EIP-8148: Custom sweep threshold for validators
eips.description: Allow setting custom balance thresholds for sweep withdrawals for validators with compounding withdrawal credentials (`0x02`).
eips.authors: Dmitry Gusakov (@dgusakov), Dmitry Chernukhin (@madlabman), Greg Koumoutsos (@gkoumout), Manu (@nalepae)

eips.title: EIP-8151: Account Code Restricted ecRecover
eips.description: Restrict ecRecover results to accounts with empty code or a delegation indicator

eips.title: EIP-8163: Reserve `EXTENSION (0xae)` opcode
eips.description: Reserve an opcode to be used as an extension prefix in non-Ethereum-L1 EVM chains

eips.title: EIP-8182: Private ETH and ERC-20 Transfers
eips.description: A canonical validity layer for private ETH and compatible ERC-20 transfers via a system contract and a split-proof architecture.

eips.title: EIP-8188: Last-Written Block for Accounts and Slots
eips.description: Records the last-written block number of each account and storage slot as consensus-level state metadata.
eips.authors: Wei Han Ng (@weiihann), Amirul Ashraf (@asdacap), Guillaume Ballet (@gballet), Maria Silva (@misilva73), Gary Rong (@rjl493456442), Carlos Perez (@CPerezz), Jochem Brouwer (@jochem-brouwer)

eips.title: EIP-8198: Quick Slots
eips.description: Introduce variable slot timing infrastructure and reduce slot duration.

eips.title: EIP-8200: EVMification
eips.description: Replace the RIPEMD-160, MODEXP, and BLAKE2f precompiles with equivalent EVM bytecode

eips.title: EIP-8205: Withdrawal credentials preregistration
eips.description: Bind a validator public key to withdrawal credentials before validator deposit via an EL system contract enforced by the CL
eips.authors: George Avsetsin (@avsetsin), Dmitry Gusakov (@dgusakov), Greg Koumoutsos (@gkoumout), Eugene Mamin (@TheDZhon)

eips.title: EIP-8219: Checked Arithmetic Opcodes
eips.description: Adds opcodes for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division that revert on overflow, underflow, or division by zero

eips.title: EIP-8237: Independent CL/EL Sync
eips.description: Enables independent consensus and execution layer synchronization by replacing execution_requests_root with an accumulator hash.

eips.title: EIP-8243: Batching Attestations at Source
eips.description: Allow validators scheduled for duty on the same committee to publish a single pre-aggregated attestation in place of N individual ones
eips.authors: Raúl Kripalani (@raulk), Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation), Mikhail Kalinin (@mkalinin)

eips.title: EIP-8250: Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions
eips.description: Independent nonce domains for frame transactions
eips.authors: Thomas Thiery (@soispoke), Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation), lightclient (@lightclient), Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin)

eips.title: EIP-8253: Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts
eips.description: Set nonce to 1 for accounts with empty code, zero nonce, and non-empty storage via an irregular state transition

eips.title: EIP-8268: Storage Roots in Block Access Lists
eips.description: Extend EIP-7928 with per-account post-block storage trie roots so partially stateful nodes can verify the state root

eips.title: EIP-8272: Recent Roots for Frame Transactions
eips.description: Frame transactions can declare verified recent roots
eips.authors: Thomas Thiery (@soispoke), Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin), Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation), lightclient (@lightclient)

eips.title: EIP-8279: Block Access List Byte Floor
eips.description: Meter EIP-7928 Block Access List bytes at runtime and fold them into the EIP-7623 transaction floor, capping worst-case block size.

eips.title: EIP-8298: SETCODEFROM Code Reuse Instruction
eips.description: Adds an instruction that sets an account's code hash from an existing deployed contract.
eips.authors: Liyi Guo (@colinlyguo), Ben Adams (@benaadams), Carlos Perez (@CPerezz), Nicolas Consigny (@nconsigny)

eips.title: EIP-8304: Trustless log and transaction index
eips.description: Store the root hashes of index tables in a system contract to allow efficient trustless proofs of log and transaction lookups

eips.title: EIP-8321: Hash-Chain RANDAO
eips.description: Replace the BLS-signature RANDAO reveal with a post-quantum hash-chain commit-reveal scheme
eips.authors: Kevaundray Wedderburn (@kevaundray), Benedikt Wagner (@benedikt-wagner), Tom Wambsgans (@TomWambsgans), Justin Drake (@JustinDrake), Thomas Coratger (@tcoratger)

eips.title: EIP-8333: Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Block
eips.description: Resolve FFG checkpoints to the last block before the epoch instead of the first block of the epoch

eips.title: EIP-8334: Bundled Attestation Propagation
eips.description: A system for broadcasting attestations in bundles using gossipsub partial messages

eips.title: EIP-8341: Partial Execution Payload Commitments
eips.description: Replace the block hash commitment in ePBS builder bids with a partial payload commitment that excludes the state root

eips.title: EIP-8355: Precompiles for ML-DSA Verification
eips.description: Three precompiles verifying ML-DSA signatures from a concatenated public key, signature, and trailing message

eips.title: EIP-8358: Net Gas Metering for Account Changes
eips.description: Make repeated value transfers cheaper by charging account changes once per transaction and refunding accounts that return to original state

eips.title: EIP-8359: Beacon Block Reporting Field
eips.description: Adds a beacon block body field for validator client and setup reporting.

eips.title: EIP-8363: Tapered Issuance Burn
eips.description: Burn a fraction of validator rewards that rises with the staking ratio, removing the issuance incentive to stake more than 50% of all ETH
eips.authors: pintail (@pintail-xyz), Jérôme de Tychey (@jdetychey), dapplion (@dapplion), pa7x1 (@pa7x1), Ladislaus von Daniels (@ladidan), Justin Drake (@justindrake)

eips.title: EIP-8365: BLS withdrawal credential retirement
eips.description: Exit validators with 0x00 withdrawal credentials and stop creating new ones, keeping the credential change path open

eips.title: EIP-8367: Balance sunset for retired BLS validators
eips.description: Gradually reduce balances of retired 0x00 validators to zero on a published schedule ahead of the post-quantum transition

eips.title: EIP-8368: CPSB Recalibration for New Gas Limit
eips.description: Re-derives the cost per state byte (CPSB) parameter introduced in EIP-8037 for a new reference block gas limit

eips.title: EIP-8369: VOPS Profiles for FOCIL Eligibility
eips.description: Describes VOPS profiles that a future FOCIL extension could use to determine which transactions receive inclusion enforcement.

eips.title: EIP-8371: RowDAS - Distributed Blob Reconstruction
eips.description: Distribute reconstruction load in the network through row-level cell messaging.

eips.title: EIP-8372: Normalized state gas limit
eips.description: Scales and normalizes the state-gas limit to better balance state-gas and execution-gas utilization.

eips.title: EIP-8374: Persist Warm Access Sets Across Reverts
eips.description: Accessed addresses and storage keys stay warm when a call frame reverts, as the data is already loaded by the client

eips.title: EIP-8375: ePBS Mandatory Burn of Execution Rewards
eips.description: Burns priority fees and targets external builder bids subject to a PTC-observed competitive floor.

eips.title: EIP-8379: Top-up Sync
eips.description: CL-driven EL synchronization by exposing the execution client head and distinguishing missing state from missing history in the engine API

eips.title: EIP-8383: Reduce CL Block Retention Window
eips.description: Reduce required beacon block retention window to 8192 epochs
